Check a long diet table against a spec before any work is done

Source: R/dv_spec.R
dv_validate.Rd

Stops on problems DietView cannot work around (a declared column is missing, there is no prey key, a weight is negative) and warns about the ones that change what the figures mean (prey keys that are not AphiaIDs, records with no prey key, weights that are not numbers, stomach IDs shared between predators). It then prints a one-line description of the sample. It reports; it does not repair.

Usage

dv_validate(data, spec, strict_covariates = TRUE, quiet = FALSE)

Arguments

data

A data.frame, one row per prey record.

spec

A dietview_spec from dv_spec().

strict_covariates

If TRUE (default) a declared covariate missing from data is an error; if FALSE it is dropped from the spec with a warning.

quiet

Suppress the summary and the informational messages (warnings and errors are never suppressed).

Value

data, invisibly, with two attributes: dv_spec (the spec, minus any dropped covariates) and dv_report (a list of counts).

Details

A missing weight or digestion column is not an error: it only disables the weight views or the digestion diagnostic, and is reported as a message.

Examples

# the standard set-up: public ICES data, non-food items and nematodes dropped
phylum <- ices_lineage$phylum[match(ices_diet$prey_aphia_id, ices_lineage$prey_aphia_id)]
dat <- ices_diet[ices_diet$item_type != "non_food" & !phylum %in% "Nematoda", ]
spec <- dv_spec(
  predator       = "predator_common",
  predator_latin = "predator_latin",
  stomach        = "stomach_id",
  prey_id        = "prey_aphia_id",
  prey_name      = "prey_name",
  weight         = "prey_weight_g",
  count          = "prey_count",
  digestion      = "digestion_label",
  covariates     = c("region", "year", "quarter")
)
v <- dv_validate(dat, spec)
#> 8530 records from 4222 stomachs of 22 predator(s); 2305 stomach(s) hold a single record; 531 record(s) lack a weight.
attr(v, "dv_report")
#> $n_records
#> [1] 8530
#> 
#> $n_stomachs
#> [1] 4222
#> 
#> $n_predators
#> [1] 22
#> 
#> $n_single_record_stomachs
#> [1] 2305
#> 
#> $n_missing_weight
#> [1] 531
#> 
#> $n_no_prey_key
#> [1] 0
#>
